Title: BMW Label

Condition To Print: The labels gets triggered upon HU weigh update

Additional Info.Printer: Printer details can be obtained from condition records. Else retrieve printer from user parameter with PARID = ZRF_PRINTER
Additional Info.Details:
Condition record to be maintained w.r.t packaging material and ship to party. 
 2. Maintain table zt0430 with Ship to party to display last 9 digits of HU and to display last 8 digits for delivery
